name: What information should I provide to get an accurate exterior painting estimate?

mainEntity.name: What information should I provide to get an accurate exterior painting estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: To receive an accurate exterior painting estimate, provide information such as the approximate square footage of your home, the type of siding, and any specific areas of concern or repair needs. You should also specify your preferred paint colors and finishes. Providing photos of the property, especially areas with damage or unique architectural features, can also help us prepare a more precise preliminary estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Provide home square footage, siding type, repair needs, and preferred colors for an accurate painting estimate.
